name: Solo Activities
description: Individual adult poses, practical activities and fantasy gestures for one person, A. Each entry gives support, reach or hand use; fantasy actions suit requests that allow them.
entries: A seated at a desk, writing with one hand while the other keeps the page flat.
A kneeling beside a planting bed, lowering a seedling into a hole with both hands around its root ball.
A standing at an easel, holding a brush in one hand and a palette in the other.
A seated with a guitar across their lap, one hand on the neck and the other over the strings.
A standing beside a bicycle, leaning it slightly toward their hip while fastening a bag to its rack.
A reaching across a counter to wipe it with a cloth, supporting their weight with the other hand on the near edge.
A standing with feet apart and hands supporting their lower back, gently arching their upper back without bending their knees backward.
A standing with torso facing away and head turned over one shoulder, keeping their hips aligned with their planted feet.
A standing with one hand resting on their hip, weight over one leg and the other knee relaxed.
A standing at a cooking surface, stirring a pan with one hand while holding its handle steady with the other.
A seated with their back supported, holding an open book above their lap and looking down at its pages.
A walking along a path with one foot planted and the other stepping forward, holding a folded map at their side.
A standing with feet braced apart, extending one open hand toward a suspended fireball while keeping the other hand near their chest.
A kneeling beside a drawn symbol, one hand hovering over its center and the other resting on their raised knee.
A standing with both palms raised beneath several small levitating objects, leaving a visible gap between hands and objects.
Lunge: A stepping one foot forward with the front knee bent above the ankle, rear leg extended behind and torso upright.
Cross-legged seat: A sitting upright with shins crossed in front, hands resting on their knees and weight supported by the ground.
A crouching on both feet beside a small object, one hand reaching toward it and the other resting on a knee for balance.
A kneeling on one knee to fasten a bag, the opposite foot planted in front and the bag resting on the ground within reach.
A reaching up to a shelf with one arm, feet flat on the ground and the other hand resting against the shelf's side for balance.
A seated on a low support, leaning forward to tie one shoe with both hands while the other foot remains on the ground.
A bending forward from the hips to inspect a surface, one palm braced beside the area being examined and the other holding a small tool.
A stepping sideways over a low obstacle, one foot planted beyond it and the other lifted clear, with arms extended for balance.
A standing beside a work surface, holding a small part at chest height in one hand and turning it with a tool in the other.
